jobs.occupation: Deck Officers with DP Unlimited and Strong English Skills for Dredgers
jobs.description:
Deck Officers with DP Unlimited and Strong English Skills for Dredgers

We are seeking skilled and motivated Deck Officers to join our modern fleet of Trailing Suction Hopper Dredgers operating on projects worldwide.

As a Deck Officer, you will play a vital role in the safe navigation, operation, and maneuvering of our vessels. Working in ports, coastal waters, and busy maritime environments, you will contribute to delivering complex dredging projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and operational excellence.

You will become part of an international team where collaboration, innovation, and continuous development are highly valued.

Your Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

• Hold a valid Certificate of Competency as Master or Chief Mate, at least up to 3,000 GT

• Possess all required and valid STCW certifications

• Hold a valid DP Unlimited Certificate

• Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to a minimum B2 level (CEFR)

• Demonstrate professionalism and sound decision-making abilities

• Are proactive, reliable, and committed to maintaining high safety standards

• Can work independently while contributing positively to a multicultural team environment

• Thrive in a dynamic operational setting with varied challenges and responsibilities

• Are willing and prepared to take part in all required onboard operations, supporting both bridge and deck duties as operational needs require

It Will Be Considered an Advantage If You Have

• Previous experience on dredgers, offshore support vessels, or other DP-operated vessels

• Experience from dredging, offshore construction, marine engineering, or the fishing industry

• Experience working with international and multicultural crews

• Familiarity with advanced maritime equipment and vessel management systems

• Experience operating in coastal areas

What We Offer

• Permanent employment opportunities within a growing international organization

• Competitive salary and benefits package

• Equal-time rotation schedule (typically 3–4 weeks on/off)

• Comprehensive onboarding and vessel-specific training

• Opportunities for professional development and career progression

• Modern vessels equipped with advanced technology

• A supportive and professional working environment with strong teamwork both on board and ashore

• Diverse international projects and operational experience worldwide

Join Our Team

We are looking for dedicated maritime professionals who take pride in their work and are ready to contribute to the successful delivery of challenging marine projects.

If you are seeking a rewarding career with opportunities for growth, development, and international experience, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today by submitting your application and relevant certificates through [https://rohde-nielsen.dk/karriere](https://rohde-nielsen.dk/karriere**.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as suitable candidates are identified.**

NORTH is looking for talented students with business backgrounds who aspire towards a career within management consulting. As a Business Analyst, you will get the chance to work directly with our clients on diverse strategy and technology projects with a focus on sales and service operations.

Your responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Together with your team, you will be engaged in commercial transformation projects for a variety of clients, where you will act as an advisor in building solutions for business challenges in a sales and/or service context. You will typically be involved in all project phases, focusing on understanding business objectives and identifying possible solutions, which will rely heavily on technology, e.g., a Salesforce implementation or another CRM platform. Your responsibilities will be:

• 
Assisting in designing winning commercial strategies and delivering commercial excellence projects

• 
Conducting qualitative and quantitative analyses to identify, understand, and address client challenges

• 
Effectively visualising and communicating complex analyses to client

• 
Performing analyses of commercial processes in sales and service functions to define one global operating model

Your skills and experience

To succeed in the role, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferably, you have knowledge or experience with strategic management, commercial excellence, or sales- and service processes. As a person, you have a high level of drive and like to have a responsibility, where you continuously seek to improve the quality of your work. You are curious, learn to dare, and are comfortable in teams with an empathic mindset. You have the following skills and experience:

• 
You are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business and have demonstrated a strong academic performance

• 
You have student job or internship experience from a consulting company or commercial experience from a C25 company

• 
You have a strong commercial mindset, seeking to improve sales and profitability

• 
You have an interest in working in the field between business and technology

• 
You can communicate complex problems and solutions in a simple understandable way, both verbally, in writing, and visually

• 
You have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels

• 
You have excellent language skills in English

We expect you to be flexible and co-operative and can work independently under changing conditions. You should be able to work 2-3 days a week, however, we also understand that you must attend to and prioritise your studies, and we are aware that there will be times when assignments and exams occupy you. Furthermore, it’s possible to work full-time for a short or long period of time for example in between semesters.

What we offer you

We offer a challenging, dynamic, and welcoming environment, where you will get the opportunity to work with global transformation projects. You will get excellent development opportunities among highly competent and ambitious colleagues and leaders as well as regular mentoring and feedback to support your rapid development. You will work with a high degree of freedom and extensive responsibility while getting support from your team in an effort to become better at helping our clients create exceptional results continually.

You will get a unique opportunity to influence projects and your position in a rapidly developing environment. Last but not least, you will join a culture with a family vibe, a down-to-earth spirit, and a social gathering agenda.

How you apply

Please submit your motivational letter, CV, and university transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews are arranged selectively.

To apply for this role, you must hold a valid work permit that allows for employment in Denmark and permits international travel on par with EU/EFTA citizenship rights.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Any questions? Reach out to

Sofie Hummer

Sofie is a Consultant and is responsible for project deliverables. She supports our clients with commercial excellence through process optimisation and the improvement of commercial performance.

Sofie comes with a background in Finance and Strategic Management from Copenhagen Business School.

sh@north.consulting

Do you want to set the technical direction and design Business Central solutions that hold up in practice?

Kolding harbour with a tall ship, warehouses and reflections in the water — a few metres from DynaFlow’s offices

Our offices sit a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding.

At DynaFlow we are looking for a Solution Architect who wants to set the technical direction and help build one of the strongest Business Central environments in the country. We bring many years of experience from larger consultancies, and we use it to design solutions that hold up — even when the landscape is complex.

About DynaFlow

At DynaFlow we believe in a different way of being a consultancy. Good advice does not start with technology, PowerPoints or processes — it starts with people, business and understanding.

We specialise in Dynamics NAV and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and have gathered more than 50 years of combined experience with solutions across industries, countries and organisations. Our clients range from large international groups to small and medium-sized businesses. For us, quality matters more than quantity, and we never leave a client stranded on the quayside.

About the role

As a Solution Architect you become the professional anchor when solutions are designed and the architecture is set. You translate the client’s business into robust, maintainable Business Central solutions — and you are the one colleagues and partners spar with when things get complex.

You work closely with consultants and developers, set the technical direction and make sure the solutions make sense both now and in the longer term. You get plenty of freedom to shape how we build.

Your tasks will include:

• Designing solutions and architecture that match the client’s business

• Technical direction and quality assurance across projects

• Breaking complex ERP landscapes into robust, maintainable solutions

• Sparring with other Business Central partners on complex tasks

• Professional sparring partner for consultants and developers

• Helping develop DynaFlow’s technical foundation, methods and standards

We imagine that you

• Have deep technical experience with Business Central/NAV, ideally at least 5 years

• Can design architecture and set technical direction in complex solutions

• Turn business needs into durable technical solutions

• Take independent ownership of quality, direction and momentum

• Communicate clearly with management, key users, developers and partners alike

• Thrive with freedom under responsibility, and bring humour and team spirit

• Speak and write fluent Danish, and preferably English

What we offer

• A central technical role in an ambitious, growing Business Central company

• The chance to help build one of the strongest Business Central environments in the country

• Plenty of freedom to set direction and shape how we build

• Complex work for both international groups and small/medium-sized businesses

• Skilled colleagues with deep consulting and business experience

• A strong team culture with room for humour, sparring and professional growth

• The option to work from home and flexible working hours

• Canteen lunch scheme

• Pension with a health-insurance scheme

• Paid phone and internet

• Premium offices a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding

How to apply

Send your application and CV to kontakt@dynaflow.dk. We invite candidates to interviews on a rolling basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to call Chris or Rasmus. We look forward to hearing from you.

Chris Erik Jensen

Rasmus Torpe

Compliance Coordinator

Purpose

The Compliance Coordinator supports the compliance team in ensuring that construction sites are operated safely, efficiently, and in line with applicable regulations. Acting as the link between site management and contractors, the role secures that all personnel have the required permits, certificates, and training to maintain a safe working environment.

Tasks and Actions in the Project

• 
Document Verification: Review and verify access permits, training certificates, and other relevant documentation for contractors and employees.

• 
System Registration: Ensure accurate registration in compliance systems and maintain up-to-date documentation.

• 
Collaboration: Work closely with site management and contractors to secure compliance with all requirements.

• 
Process Support: Contribute to a safe and efficient work environment by ensuring structure, oversight, and clear processes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• 
Experience: Previous experience in administration, documentation control, or compliance is advantageous but not mandatory. Construction-related experience is a plus.

• 
Skills:

• 
Strong administrative and organizational skills.

• 
Attention to detail and reliability.

• 
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Clear communication and teamwork abilities.

• 
Education: Secondary education (e.g. high school) or equivalent.

• 
Other Requirements:

• 
Valid driver’s license.

• 
Fluency in English (written and spoken).

We Offer

• 
A central role in a dedicated compliance team on some of Denmark’s largest and most complex construction projects.

• 
A position with direct impact on safety and compliance on site.

• 
Thorough onboarding and training in systems and processes.

• 
Opportunities for professional development in a growing company.

• 
Roles available across several locations (e.g. Hillerød, Roskilde, Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Køge).

Are you an expert at cracking algorithms and ensuring maximum organic visibility – not just on Google, but also in the AI-driven searches of the future? Do you want to lead data-driven SEO strategies and pave the way for GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for national and international brands?

At Iternum Digital in Frederiksberg, we are well underway in redefining what organic visibility means. We are looking for a sharp SEO profile who wants to take ownership of our GEO and AI initiatives, ensuring our clients are visible right where the consumers of tomorrow are searching for answers.

Specialist in Organic Visibility (SEO & GEO)

As our SEO & GEO Consultant, you will have full responsibility for your own client portfolio and the entire process from strategy to execution:

- Strategic and technical SEO

You analyze, plan, and execute technical SEO optimizations, content strategies, and link building that drive relevant traffic and growth.

- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

You ensure our clients’ brands are visible where tomorrow’s searches take place. You optimize content so it is retrieved and recommended by AI search engines and AI chatbots (such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Perplexity).

- AI-driven optimization

You are naturally curious about AI and actively use the latest tools (e.g., for data analysis, keyword clustering, content briefs, and competitor monitoring) to streamline your processes and create extraordinary results.

- Data and analytics

You monitor performance, dive deep into data, and visualize the efforts for the client in an easy-to-understand way, making the value of the organic work always crystal clear.

- Advisory and sparring

You act as the client’s primary sparring partner, leading performance meetings with confidence and educating them on how AI search (GEO) is changing the digital landscape.

- Business development

You play an active and central role in further developing our SEO and GEO services, helping to shape processes, best practices, and the future setup of our agency.

Who are you?

You combine technical SEO insight with a sharp commercial understanding and a strong desire to innovate:

• Experience: You have at least 1-2 years of experience with SEO, preferably from an agency or an in-house marketing department.

• Toolbox in order: You are well-versed in classic SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics and Screaming Frog.

• Tech and AI curious: You closely follow Large Language Models (LLMs) and Search Generative Experience (SGE), and you love experimenting with new AI technologies to automate and optimize your work.

• Commercial mindset: You understand that SEO is not just about rankings, but about creating great content and user experiences that support the client's business and KPIs.

• Team player: You are proactive, structured, and ready to collaborate and share your knowledge within a team of over 20 skilled specialists.

Why Iternum Digital?

We offer a work environment where there is a short path from idea to action, and where social connection and professional curiosity are highly prioritized:

• Freedom with responsibility: You get a high degree of autonomy and a direct influence on the agency's growth and our GEO focus.

• Terms to match your talent: A competitive salary package based on qualifications, including a pension scheme and health insurance.

• Fuel for your workday: Free access to delicious breakfast, snacks, candy, and coffee – or whatever else you need to keep your energy levels peaked.

• Social DNA: We believe the best results are created by a close-knit team. That’s why we regularly host workshops, Friday bars, cinema nights, and dinner outings.

Are you ready to shape the future of organic search at Iternum Digital?

Send a motivated application along with your CV to job@iternumdigital.com. If you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to reach out to us.

We look forward to hearing how you will use your experience and passion for AI to make a real difference for our clients!

Katharina Rendtslev

COO & Partner

About Iternum Digital as a workplace

Iternum Digital is a digital and creative marketing agency based in Frederiksberg, specializing in SEO, PPC, Social Media, Web Development, CRO, and Digital Analytics. Our team of 20+ specialists works together to create strong and valuable digital presences for both national and international clients. We take a long-term and holistic approach, developing a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses and overall marketing activities.

At Iternum, you’ll join an informal and social workplace where collaboration and good vibes are top priorities. We regularly host internal workshops, team-building activities, dinners, movie nights, Friday bars, and parties – because we believe a strong team is built not only at the desk, but through shared experiences and fun together.

DESIGN OF INTELIGENT HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS FOR CUSTOMIZED BRAKING APPLICATIONS

Vejstrup

Can you see yourself working in a well-established Application & Control department with competent and motivated colleagues? Can you envision yourself designing solutions that create safety and security in every type of braking application where large forces or special conditions apply?

Then you might be the next engineer to join the team at Svendborg Brakes.

Develop innovative brake solutions for demanding applications

Together with your competent colleagues in the Application & Control Department, you will be involved in projects related to customer-specific applications. These applications must function in environments such as underwater turbines, submarines, elevators, or at high altitudes in the mountains of Tibet. The applications are diverse and offer plenty of design challenges.

Based on specifications and timelines, projects are led by a Project Manager. This allows you to focus on the technical aspects of the projects as well as managing your own project timeline. Your tasks will include:

• 
Technical adjustments of the core product and components for braking systems

• 
Design and construction of braking systems and components, including hydraulic systems

• 
Leading and ensuring the execution of testing these designs in the test center and production facilities

• 
Preparing technical documentation, including drawings and bills of materials (BOMs)

• 
Participation in development projects, including new material types and customer-specific projects.

Your typical workday will be a mix of independent work and a cross-functional collaboration, as solutions are often found through interdisciplinary collaboration. Among other things, you will work closely with a technical designer who supports you by creating technical documentation.

Svendborg Brakes has its own hydraulic manufacturing and test center, where designs can be tested and where customers visit to follow the project progress. This means you will be able to see your projects through from start to finish.

You are passionate about engineering and intelligent hydraulic systems

We are looking for an engineer with a strong passion for engineering and hydraulics. You have both an interest in and experience with mechanical design, hydraulics, and electrical control systems, and you are motivated by continuously developing your skills. You most likely hold a degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering and have at least three years of professional experience.

You take a structured approach to your work and maintain a strong overview of tasks and processes. You understand that respecting specifications and timelines leads to the best results and strongest collaboration. You communicate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds and interact effortlessly with both customers and colleagues across departments.

In addition, you are fully comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Do you want to join the team?

At Svendborg Brakes, you will experience a flat organizational structure and an informal culture, where you have the freedom to plan your own workday and the projects you are involved in. You will also be part of a close cross-functional collaboration, where colleagues complement each other across projects with their individual areas of expertise.

Svendborg Brakes’ willingness and motivation to explore new technologies - as one of the world leaders in this field - is evident throughout the company. In other words, you will join a team with high level of expertise and a strong dedication to continuous development. This gives you a unique opportunity to develop your skills based on your interests and motivation.

Contact Lene Mølholm or Marco Rosenlund Jespersen at Peoplelink on +45 6610 2015 or Technical Manager, Hydraulics & SOBO, Nikolaj Pave at Svendborg Brakes on +45 5214 0267, if you want to learn more about the position, or send us your application as soon as possible.

Read about what requirements you need to meet in order to be considered for the job below as well as what the job entails.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Your new workplace

You have to like using your body when working, love interacting with people, and you have be able to work on a team under pressure. In return, you will find that your “flyers” give you a lot of good energy return when they give you a highfive or a hug after a great experience.

The most important task of an Indoor Skydiving instructor is to ensure that each customer gets a safe and comfortable flying experience. You must instruct, assist and support the customer before, during and after the flight. In the long run, you can become a coach for professional parachutists.

Customer service experience including good listening & coaching skills

You are self-driven, detail-oriented and have the ability to organize and prioritize. You are able to follow routines and procedures

• 
Physical strength and agility – you should be prepared to catch or correct a person weighing up to 120 kg in the wind tunnel

Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required in both Danish and English

This is an application to join our team as an intern for a semester in Copenhagen.

We are GXN

GXN is a strategic consultancy for the built environment, founded by 3XN in 2007, with offices in Copenhagen and London. We believe that we can design, build, and live in ways that better align human and planetary needs. GXN leads teams in impactful strategic innovation and design-led research. We connect stakeholders across the building industry with cities and local communities for a more inclusive and participatory design process. We are personal, agile, and see constraints as creative drivers for our work and solutions.

Read more about who we are, and explore our work here: What exactly does gxn do? inside 3xn´s design-driven research studio | 3XN

The Internship

Experience working on our core team and contributing directly to the development of our projects, across a wide range of scales, typologies, formats, and locations. We offer two cycles of six-month-long internships per year, with the possibility of extending. Please indicate in your application which cycle you are applying to.

- 1st semester: from January to August. We accept applications from October, and we will respond in mid-November.

- 2nd semester: from August to January. We accept applications from March to April, and we will respond in mid-May.

Several elements make our office and our work unique. You will work with architects, behavioural designers, circular design specialists, engineers and even an anthropologist. You will be working with a range of exciting tools and processes, from material innovation to masterplans, from forensic material studies to co-design workshops, which will develop unique and valuable skills.

Your Qualifications

- a student still enrolled in a university

- that has completed at least 2,5 years of relevant studies (architecture, engineering, urban design, etc.)

- confident using Rhino and Adobe

- fluent in English

- a passionate team player

Advantages if you:

- speak a Scandinavian language

- have an interest or experience in behavioural-driven / circular / urban design / computational design

- have experience quantifying sustainability in the built environment (such as doing life cycle assessments)

If you have any questions about this position, you can contact Aleksander Guldager Kongshaug at agk@3xn.dk

Our Business Development & Portfolio Management area has an ambitious strategy and we are looking for someone with a generic-pharma mindset or experience to drive the transformation and make sure we execute according to our plans, roadmaps and business goals within the area and along the value chain

About the job

This role is best suited for someone who knows how a generic pharma business operates. Compared with an originator company, we work with a broad portfolio, lean teams and short decision paths, and value comes from pragmatic, commercially minded execution.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive the transformation in the Business Development & Portfolio Management area from process changes to new ways of working

• Identify program impacts and design adoption measures together with functional leads

• Track adoption and take corrective action when change is not landing as planned

• Own the communication plan that keeps the organization informed and engaged

• Own the strategy execution roadmap for the Business Development & Portfolio Management area, ensuring alignment with Orifarm’s overall strategy and business goals

• Translate priorities into concrete program briefs, project charters, milestones and benefit maps

• Follow up on progress against plans and goals – with a single, transparent view of status, risks, dependencies and benefit realization

• Drive cross-functional coordination along the value chain – Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Business Development, Commercial and Operations – and ensure timely resolution of blockers

• Run the governance rhythm: program boards, track reviews and reporting to the Executive Management Group

You will report directly to our Chief Business Development & Portfolio Strategy Officer. You will present strategy updates and projects to our Executive Management Group and hold an explicit mandate to drive execution across the organization.

Who are you

We are looking for someone with significant experience driving transformations or programs in complex organizations, and a track record of making sure plans are executed and business goals are delivered.

Additionally, you will need to have experience from a generic or off-patent pharma business – across areas such as portfolio, business development, regulatory or commercial operations and you know how it differs from an originator company: broad portfolios, lean organizations, tight margins and pragmatic decision-making. Experience from a comparable commercial healthcare environment is also relevant.

You communicate clearly with executives, build alignment across functions, markets and cultures, and are comfortable challenging when progress stalls. You also ensure the right level of structure and governance for a regulated environment without building heavier processes than the business needs

Lastly, you have strong analytical skills, hold complexity across several concurrent workstreams and master program management methods and tools. A certification such as PRINCE2, MSP or PMI-PgMP is an advantage.

Who are we?

The Business Development & Portfolio Management area covers Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance. You will partner closely with Strategy, the Strategy & PPMO Office, People & Culture and other corporate functions.

What we offer

• A role at the center of strategic decision-making, with direct access to the C-level and the Executive Management Group

• A clear mandate to drive execution across the organization

• An entrepreneurial culture that celebrates can-do attitudes, smarts and hearts, and a strong feedback culture that supports your development

• Flexibility and a strong commitment to work-life balance in an international setting with opportunities for growth

• A bonus scheme that includes every employee when we have good results

• A great canteen, massage service at our Odense office and social events throughout the year

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

Odense, Denmark. You will work from our Odense office 2–3 days a week to be close to the majority of your stakeholders. We welcome candidates based outside Denmark who can commit to this whether by commuting or relocating (relocation support and expenses will be covered by Orifarm).

Application deadline

As soon as possible.

As Process Cleaning Engineer, you will help establish a brand-new API purification facility by making sure its process equipment can be cleaned reliably and in line with GMP. You will take cleaning from design through commissioning, qualification and validation, working closely with engineering, automation, validation and manufacturing colleagues. Your work helps build production capacity that is flexible and ready for future growth, supporting people living with serious chronic diseases around the world.

What you’ll bring

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemistry or a related discipline.

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment, preferably in pharmaceutical, biotech or API manufacturing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical production processes, process equipment, validation activities and GMP documentation practices.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

• The ability to collaborate across disciplines, work through technical challenges and take ownership in a regulated, project-driven environment.

We are hiring several Process Cleaning Engineers and welcome applications from people with different levels of experience. What matters most is how you collaborate, solve problems and deliver quality.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience with Cleaning-in-Place (CIP), cleaning validation, qualification activities or process engineering.

• Danish language skills.

What you’ll do

You will be part of a major expansion project, helping design, develop, validate and implement cleaning processes that meet both regulatory requirements and day-to-day operational needs.

• Drive Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) activities across the project lifecycle, from design and commissioning through qualification and validation.

• Take part in design reviews, risk assessments, engineering runs, riboflavin testing, verification activities and troubleshooting.

• Support validation activities and make sure work meets GMP requirements and internal quality standards.

• Work with contractors, engineering partners, project teams and manufacturing representatives to keep decisions clear and work moving.

• Contribute to risk management and continuous improvement, and help shape future standards for cleaning processes in API manufacturing.

Who you’ll work with

You will join PS API Expansions, part of API Manufacturing in Global Manufacturing & Supply. The team designs, plans and delivers major API capacity expansion projects across Novo, building flexible, future-ready production facilities for the people who need our treatments.

Your closest partners will be engineering, automation and validation specialists, along with project teams, contractors and manufacturing colleagues, both internal and external. The team works across disciplines, functions and geographies, and shares knowledge to keep these strategic projects on track.

You will report to Manager Guilherme Sales or Allan Feldtskov, who can tell you more about the team and the role.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to influence technical decisions and contribute to the successful delivery of a facility that supports Novo’s future growth. You will work with state-of-the-art technologies and ambitious sustainability targets, and build new skills through hands-on experience in a large-scale pharmaceutical project.

You will be supported to perform at your best in a team where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are part of daily work, and where your voice is heard.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DK to 838,100 DKK corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

Work in Denmark as a butcher– attractive salary, flexibility and stable working conditions

For our customer, Danish Crown - one of Europe’s largest food companies - we are looking for experienced pork butchers for shoulder deboning (pork front ends) at abattoirs in Blans, Denmark.

Working in Denmark means clear employment conditions under collective agreements, pension schemes, paid holidays and stable working conditions. At Danish Crown you will join an international workplace with colleagues from many different countries.

The work is guided by clear values. Safety first is the most important principle – employees must always be able to work safely and return home safely every day.

Danish Crown is also focusing strongly on employee well-being and development. Employees should feel comfortable in their work, understand their role in the production and see how their contribution creates value for the company.

The company culture is based on teamwork, responsibility and mutual respect, where colleagues support each other and everyone is treated fairly.

Please note:  You will be employed directly by Danish Crown from your first day of work

Job tasks

• Deboning of pork shoulders (front ends)

• Knife work in high-volume pork production

• Ensuring correct cutting and optimal meat yield

• Following hygiene and safety procedures

• Supporting other tasks in the cutting room when required

Candidate requirements

• Experience with deboning

• Preferably experience with pork shoulders / front ends

• Good knife skills

• Experience from a abattoirs or meat processing plant

• Ability to work in a fast-paced production environment

• Physically fit and reliable

Candidates must be able to work independently with deboning from the first working days.

Salary and working conditions

• Hourly wage according to the collective agreement: DKK 176.10 plus a flexible benefits allowance of 12.20% = DKK 197.58 per hour.

• After a short accomodation period, the salary will switch to piecework (akkord), where the hourly rate will increase significantly.

• Possibility of higher earnings depending on function and performance

• Flexible benefit scheme (extra pay or extra time off)

• Canteen facilities

• Opportunities for training and development

We also offer:

• Admininstrative assistance with CPR number, tax card, healt insurance, and more.

• Help with accomodation near the working place.

• Support in multiple languages ( English, Danish, Romanian, Polish, more)

• Guidance regarding Danish work and living culture.

Working hours

Day shift

Monday – Friday

40 hours per week

Employees accumulate additional hours that can be used for time off.

If flexible benefits and accumulated hours are used for time off, employees can potentially have up to around 10 weeks of time off per year.

Evening shift

32-hour work week distributed across 4 working days.

Employees on the evening shift do not accumulate extra hours, but instead have a weekly rotating day off, which means that approximately every fifth weekend they can have both Friday and Monday off.

Evening shift employees also receive additional evening pay for many of their working hours.

Application

If you are interested in the job, please complete the application form and attach your CV as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Head of International Staffing, Andrei Maierean, at +45 61 63 07 19 or Staffing Consultant, Damian Bukowski, at +45 73 32 37 53 on weekdays between 08:00 and 16:00.

JKS conducts interviews on an ongoing basis, and the positions may be filled before the application deadline.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Arbeiten Sie in Dänemark als Fleischer – attraktives Gehalt, Flexibilität und stabile Arbeitsbedingungen

Für unseren Kunden Danish Crown, eines der größten Lebensmittelunternehmen Europas, suchen wir erfahrene Schweinefleischer für das Ausbeinen von Schultern (Vorderteile) in einem Schlachthof in Blans, Dänemark.

Arbeiten in Dänemark bedeutet klare Beschäftigungsbedingungen auf Grundlage von Tarifverträgen, Rentenregelungen, bezahlten Urlaub und stabile Arbeitsverhältnisse. Bei Danish Crown werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Arbeitsumfelds mit Kollegen aus vielen verschiedenen Ländern.

Die Arbeit basiert auf klaren Werten. Sicherheit steht an erster Stelle. Mitarbeitende sollen jederzeit sicher arbeiten können und jeden Tag sicher nach Hause zurückkehren.

Danish Crown legt zudem großen Wert auf das Wohlbefinden und die Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden. Die Beschäftigten sollen sich bei ihrer Arbeit wohlfühlen, ihre Rolle in der Produktion verstehen und erkennen, wie ihr Beitrag Wert für das Unternehmen schafft.

Die Unternehmenskultur basiert auf Teamarbeit, Verantwortung und gegenseitigem Respekt. Kollegen unterstützen sich gegenseitig und alle werden fair behandelt.

Bitte beachten Sie: Sie werden vom ersten Arbeitstag an direkt bei Danish Crown angestellt.

Arbeitsaufgaben

• Ausbeinen von Schweineschultern (Vorderteile)

• Messertätigkeiten in der Schweineproduktion mit hohem Durchsatz

• Sicherstellung korrekter Zuschnitte und optimaler Fleischausbeute

• Einhaltung von Hygiene und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Unterstützung bei weiteren Aufgaben im Zerlegebereich bei Bedarf

Anforderungen

• Erfahrung im Ausbeinen

• Vorzugsweise Erfahrung mit Schweineschultern oder Vorderteilen

• Gute Messerfertigkeiten

• Erfahrung aus einem Schlachthof oder fleischverarbeitenden Betrieb

• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen Produktionsumfeld zu arbeiten

• Körperlich fit und zuverlässig

Kandidaten müssen in der Lage sein, vom ersten Arbeitstag an selbstständig ausbeinen zu können.

Gehalt und Arbeitsbedingungen

• Stundenlohn gemäß Tarifvertrag: 176,10 DKK plus flexible Zusatzleistungen von 12,20 Prozent = 197,58 DKK pro Stunde

• Nach einer kurzen Einarbeitungsphase erfolgt der Wechsel zur Akkordarbeit, wodurch der Stundenlohn deutlich steigen kann

• Möglichkeit eines höheren Einkommens je nach Funktion und Leistung

• Flexible Zusatzleistungen, entweder als zusätzliche Vergütung oder zusätzliche Freizeit

• Kantine vorhanden

• Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und Entwicklung

Zusätzlich bieten wir

• Administrative Unterstützung bei CPR-Nummer, Steuerkarte, Krankenversicherung und mehr

• Hilfe bei der Unterkunft in der Nähe des Arbeitsplatzes

• Unterstützung in mehreren Sprachen, darunter Englisch, Dänisch, Rumänisch, Polnisch und weitere

• Einführung in die dänische Arbeits- und Lebenskultur

Arbeitszeiten

Tagschicht

Montag bis Freitag

40 Stunden pro Woche

Mitarbeitende sammeln zusätzliche Stunden, die für Freizeit genutzt werden können. Wenn flexible Zusatzleistungen und angesammelte Stunden genutzt werden, sind bis zu etwa zehn Wochen Freizeit pro Jahr möglich.

Abendschicht

32 Stunden pro Woche, verteilt auf vier Arbeitstage

Mitarbeitende in der Abendschicht sammeln keine zusätzlichen Stunden, haben jedoch einen wöchentlich wechselnden freien Tag. Das bedeutet, dass sie etwa jedes fünfte Wochenende sowohl Freitag als auch Montag frei haben können.

Zusätzlich erhalten Mitarbeitende in der Abendschicht Zuschläge für viele ihrer Arbeitsstunden.

Bewerbung

Wenn Sie an der Stelle interessiert sind, füllen Sie bitte das Bewerbungsformular aus und fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf so schnell wie möglich bei.

Bei Fragen zur Position können Sie sich gerne an den Head of International Staffing, Andrei Maierean, unter +45 61 63 07 19 oder an den Staffing Consultant, Damian Bukowski, unter +45 73 32 37 53 wenden. Erreichbar werktags zwischen 08:00 und 16:00 Uhr.

JKS führt laufend Vorstellungsgespräche durch, und die Stellen können bereits vor Ablauf der Bewerbungsfrist besetzt werden.

Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören.

Are you passionate about contemporary design and bringing innovative lighting products to life?

Do you have a technical background and experience developing products from concept to production?

PRODUCT DEVELOPER – LIGHTING

Based in Copenhagen

At our office in the heart of Copenhagen, you will join our Lighting Product Development team, working closely with talented designers, colleagues across different functions and international manufacturing partners. You will play a key role in transforming creative ideas into high-quality lighting products that combine design, functionality and technical excellence.

About the job

As Product Developer – Lighting at HAY, you will be involved in developing decorative LED lighting products from initial concept to final production. Combining technical development skills with a strong understanding of design, you will work closely with designers, internal teams and international manufacturing partners to bring creative ideas to life.

An important part of your role will be to maintain the original design intent throughout the development process, while ensuring that products meet technical requirements and can be manufactured efficiently. You will help drive projects forward, balancing design, functionality, quality, cost and timelines.

Your daily tasks will include:

• Manage product development projects from initial concept to production, ensuring timelines and key deliverables are met.

• Develop decorative LED lighting solutions, including optics, thermal management, drivers and dimming technologies.

• Create detailed, production-ready 3D models, assemblies and technical drawings using SolidWorks.

• Translate design concepts into technically feasible products, developing and testing prototypes and resolving technical and manufacturing challenges.

• Prepare technical specifications, bills of materials (BOMs) and test documentation.

• Ensure compliance with relevant electrical, safety, sustainability and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate with designers, internal teams and external manufacturing partners throughout the development process.

• Manage project timelines, costs and technical deliverables, supporting suppliers with tooling, pilot production and quality control.

• Format 2D documentation utilizing Microsoft and Adobe Creative Suite packages.

Are you the Product Developer we are looking for?

We are looking for a technically skilled Product Developer who is passionate about contemporary design and has an eye for detail. You understand how to translate creative ideas into functional products without compromising the designer's original vision. You combine technical knowledge with a practical, solution-oriented approach and enjoy working at the intersection of design, engineering and manufacturing. You are comfortable taking responsibility for your projects, keeping track of timelines and collaborating with colleagues and external partners to find the best solutions.

Role expectations

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

• You enjoy collaborating with designers, colleagues and external partners.

• You are a team player who values collaboration and contributes positively to the HAY culture.

Experience required

• You have a relevant educational background in Product Development, Industrial Design, Engineering or a related field.

• You have experience in technical product development, ideally taking products from concept to production. Experience within decorative lighting is an advantage.

• You have technical knowledge of LED lighting and an understanding of relevant electrical, safety and regulatory requirements.

• You are proficient in SolidWorks, including 3D modeling, assemblies and technical drawings.

• You have experience with prototyping, testing and technical documentation, along with an understanding of materials, manufacturing processes and supplier collaboration.

• You are familiar with Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite for preparing and formatting product documentation.

• You communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken, as we are an international company.

You want to be a part of HAY?

Then do not hesitate to send us your application and CV, along with a portfolio showcasing relevant product development projects, as soon as possible and no later than Wednesday 18 November. We evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have any further questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact Recruiter, John Cain at john_cain@hermanmiller.com or Senior Manager, Sam Weller at sam.weller@hay.com.

Why join us?

Founded in Copenhagen in 2002 with the ambition of creating contemporary furniture, lighting and accessories for modern living, HAY’s vision is to create high-quality and well-designed products in collaboration with some of the world’s most talented, curious, and courageous designers. Through the commitment to sophisticated industrial manufacturing processes, HAY strives to make good design accessible to the widest possible audience.

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. We bring stories to life.

Denmark or London/Oxford, United Kingdom

Research & Development

AI & Digital Innovation, Research & Development

Your impact begins here

As AI Execution Manager, you will help shape how AI transforms Research & Development at Novo. Working at the intersection of science, digital innovation and business execution, you will partner with senior leaders, researchers and technology teams to turn strategic priorities into high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Your work will accelerate the pace at which AI and digital capabilities translate into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you'll bring

• An advanced degree (Master's or PhD preferred) in life sciences, providing the scientific foundation to engage confidently with experts across Research & Development.

• A strategic mindset with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and connect scientific and technical opportunities with broader organisational priorities.

• A proven track record of leading high-impact initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders and building alignment across complex matrix organisations to deliver measurable outcomes.

• Strong digital and AI understanding, including appreciation of how technology products and capabilities are developed, implemented and scaled within large organisations.

• A demonstrated understanding of how large pharmaceutical or life sciences organisations operate, with experience working across scientific, technical and business functions.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Desirable:

What you'll do

You will translate strategic AI and digital priorities into successful execution across Research & Development, from target discovery through to clinical development. Your focus will be on shaping, coordinating and delivering initiatives that create tangible organisational impact.

• Partner with scientific and business leaders to identify and shape high-impact AI and digital initiatives, translating opportunities into clear, actionable programmes.

• Lead complex cross-functional initiatives across R&D, including collaborations with external partners and technology leaders.

• Provide strategic guidance and coordination across AI initiatives, ensuring alignment between scientific objectives, technology capabilities and business priorities.

• Act as a trusted partner who translates between scientific, technical and business perspectives to support informed decision-making.

• Build alignment across senior stakeholders and drive complex initiatives through to successful delivery in a global matrix organisation.

Who you'll work with

You will join the AI Execution team within AI & Digital Innovation, part of Research & Development. The team partners across R&D, from target discovery through to clinical development, to identify, shape and deliver high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Working across science, technology and business, your team helps transform ambitious ideas into tangible organisational impact.

Your closest partners will include senior scientific and business leaders across R&D, technology and digital teams, and external partners. You will work across functions and organisational levels, bringing different perspectives together to build alignment and move initiatives forward with clarity and pace.

What you can expect here

You will work at the forefront of AI and digital innovation in a global healthcare company that is investing significantly in science and technology. The role offers the opportunity to shape how R&D operates, build new skills through cross-functional collaboration and grow your expertise at the intersection of science, AI and business.

You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and contribute your expertise where it matters most. The work moves at pace, and curiosity, adaptability and a drive for impact are valued every day.

jobs.occupation: Help Keep Our Capsule Hotel in Copenhagen Spotless!
jobs.description:

If you have an eye for detail and like seeing the results of your work right away, this could be the perfect fit for you.

At Capsule Hotel, we’re not just offering a place to stay, we’re redefining how people travel. By blending smart design, meaningful community, and affordability, we create memorable stays for curious explorers from all over the world. And a great stay always starts with a clean, fresh space.

What Drives Us We believe in: ✔ People First: Guests, team, and partners come first. Always. ✔ GO Big: Every idea should be scalable and impactful. ✔ Strength Oriented: Do what you’re great at; we support the rest. ✔ Adapt for the Future: Innovation keeps us ahead of the curve.

As a Housekeeper, you’ll make sure every guest walks into a clean, fresh, and welcoming hotel. You’ll work independently during your shift, managing your own tasks from start to finish.

Your Mission

• 
Clean and prepare the capsules for arriving guests, including changing bed linen

• 
Clean and refresh the bathrooms and shower areas

• 
Keep the common areas tidy and inviting

• 
Restock supplies such as towels, toiletries, and cleaning products

• 
Report any damage, maintenance issues, or lost items

• 
Make sure everything is guest-ready by the end of your shift

What’s in It for You? ✔ A short, fixed shift that fits easily around studies, family, or another job ✔ Independence: you plan your work and own the result ✔ Part of a young, international hospitality brand that’s growing ✔ Clear routines and a supportive team behind you

Are You the One? ✅ Detail-oriented with high standards for cleanliness ✅ Reliable and punctual, since the team counts on you to have everything ready on time ✅ Comfortable working alone and staying organised without supervision ✅ Physically fit and fine with an active, hands-on job ✅ Some cleaning or housekeeping experience? Great, but not required, as we’ll train you ✅ Able to communicate in English (Danish is a plus)

If this sounds like you, don’t wait. Help us create spotless stays for travellers from around the world!

 Apply now: andrea@capsulehotel.ch
